amanda: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a dynamic lease rebalance hook for Dedicated pools to handle sudden multi-tenant spikes. Thoughts?
ricardo: briefly: yes, but we need clear invariants around token accounting so we don't double-charge.
neha: are we talking about per-customer soft leases that shrink/grow based on recent 1m qps? or something longer?
amanda: thinking hybrid: short-term reactive window (30s) + stable allocation window (10m) + decay curve to avoid oscillation. goal: avoid cold starts for healthy tenants while throttling abusive sudden bursts.
chao: two immediate tradeoffs: fairness vs. predictability. aggressive rebalancing helps fairness but screws SLAs for committed customers.
sre_tony: +1 to modeling cost impact. we should simulate 100k reqs/min with different decay_half_life values.
ricardo: interface boundary idea: expose leases as a small protobuf over RLS with fields {lease_tokens, expiry, weight_hint, priority_tag}. runtime applies local adjustments but authoritative source is central allocator. keeps private deployments consistent.
amanda: prototype config snippet:
```yaml
lease_rebalance:
  reactive_window_sec: 30
  stable_window_sec: 600
  decay_half_life_sec: 120
  min_tokens_per_tenant: 50
  max_tokens_fraction: 0.25 # of pool capacity
```
neha: what about abuse signals? we should include anomaly score in the allocator so it can reduce weight_hint quickly when abuse detected.
chao: agree. abuse pipeline should send an 'abuse_penalty' that decreases lease_tokens multiplicatively, separate from normal rebalance.
infra-bot: Incident rule added: when abuse_penalty > 0.5 for a tenant, route their traffic to degraded model variant and notify #support.
ricardo: implementation detail — need safe fallback: if central allocator is unavailable, runtime must enforce local reserved minimum and capacity-proportional best-effort distribution. document that as an outage invariant.
sre_tony: also add metrics: lease_assigned_tokens, lease_effective_tokens, abuse_penalty, rebalance_ops/sec, fallback_engaged_last5m. want dashboards before enabling.
amanda: questions for design doc: 1) exact formula for token decay (linear vs exponential), 2) penalty hysteresis to prevent flip-flop, 3) telemetry hooks for ML-based abuse score, 4) privacy boundaries for Private deployments.
neha: for formula I prefer exponential decay: new_tokens = current_tokens * 2^(-dt/half_life) + recent_gain. smoother.
chao: hysteresis: require 3 consecutive windows before increasing tokens, immediate on abuse decrease (safer).
amanda: agreed. I'll update RFC follow-up with simulation results and a proposed RLS protobuf. assigning: @ricardo to draft proto, @neha to wire the abuse signal contract, @chao to run SLA impact sims, @sre_tony to create dashboards.
ricardo: will do proto draft by EOD tomorrow.
neha: starting abuse contract draft now.
sre_tony: dashboard skeleton created in grafana under infra/leases. will iterate.
amanda: thanks all. leaving open for any late comments — plan to merge the follow-up RFC in 48h unless objections. :thumbsup:
